name: braintrust
summary: I successfully installed the Braintrust SDK and dependencies (`braintrust-0.34.0`, `autoevals-0.3.0`, `openai`) and created the `movie_matcher.py` eval script following the quickstart's Python example, adapting it to use the Braintrust Gateway since no separate `OPENAI_API_KEY` was available. However, the script failed at runtime with `ConnectionResetError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer` when attempting to connect to `api.braintrust.dev`. I verified this is a sandbox-wide network restriction: `curl` to `https://www.google.com`, `https://api.braintrust.dev`, and `https://gateway.braintrust.dev` all returned the same connection reset error, while even plain HTTP requests returned `403 Forbidden` from an envoy proxy. The promised outcome—executing an eval run and reporting scores—could not be achieved because outbound HTTPS traffic is blocked in this sandbox environment, preventing any connection to Braintrust's API.
